# 2026-11-19 v6.4 D4-1 phase 2 (Alexandria, Smyrna's fall, Varna and the Hexamilion: events 4, 8-12, 14; world steps W-1 to W-3) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 D4-3 phase 1 (the Curia: two popes and the appeal for a crusade: events 20-23, the worker 91, the action oe_lat_act_appeal) added to this file by the same generator.
# Hardcoded hook appended to the existing handlers (same way as oe_tcb_reclaim.txt).
on_took_location_in_peace_treaty = { on_actions = { oe_lat_took_location } }

# root = winner, scope:location, scope:winner, scope:loser. A Catholic crusader (marked by .2 a, or a member of the
# running crusade the empire helped) takes a former Roman place (a theme region, or a former province) from a
# non-Christian: the place is listed as left behind by the crusade, for oe_lat.3. Smyrna going to the Knights is not
# listed (vanilla flavor_kni_pap.4 cedes the Smyrniote conquests to them).
oe_lat_took_location = {
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                country_exists = c:BYZ
                exists = scope:winner
                exists = scope:loser
                exists = scope:location
                scope:winner = {
                    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
                    religion = religion:catholic
                    OR = {
                        has_variable = oe_lat_crusader
                        AND = {
                            exists = international_organization:crusade
                            is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:crusade
                            c:BYZ = { var:oe_lat_cru_side ?= 1 }
                        }
                    }
                }
                scope:loser = { NOT = { religion.group = religion_group:christian } }
                scope:location = {
                    OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_region has_variable = oe_tw_former_province }
                    NOT = { AND = { this = location:smyrna scope:winner = { tag = KNI } } }
                }
            }
            scope:location = { oe_lat_mark = { who = scope:winner } }
        }
    }
}
